title: How much a bathroom renovation costs in Kyiv and what drives the price
seo_title: Bathroom Renovation Cost in Kyiv: What Drives the Price
description: Bathroom renovation cost in Kyiv: what makes up the price, what adds to it, where not to cut corners and how to get an honest estimate after a survey.
lead: The search for a bathroom renovation price in Kyiv usually starts with a figure per square metre. But the bathroom is the most complex room in any renovation, and its cost depends on several decisions. Here is what that cost is made of and how to get an honest estimate.

body: h2
Why there is no separate price for a bathroom
p

A bathroom is a small area with a large amount of work: water supply, drainage, electrics, waterproofing, tiling, ventilation. That is why the same room can cost very different amounts depending on the decisions made. We do not quote a universal figure “per bathroom”: the cost depends on the design, the materials and the condition of the room. The benchmark we can confirm is a turnkey apartment renovation from $550 per m². If the bathroom is part of an [apartment renovation](/en/turnkey-renovation), it is counted in the overall estimate. The exact figure for the bathroom itself comes from the estimate after a survey.
h2
What makes up the cost of a bathroom renovation
ul
stripping out old tiles and sanitary ware, and removing the debris
water and drainage pipework, electrics, ventilation
waterproofing of the floor and wet areas, a screed with the correct slopes
tiles and tiling: layout, cutting, grouting
sanitary ware, mixer taps, concealed cistern frames, the shower area
vanity units, mirrors, lighting
underfloor heating, the door, the ceiling
p

It is also worth separating works from materials. Works are what the crew does; the materials and sanitary ware you choose yourself, and their cost can differ several times over. That is why our estimate splits these two parts, so you can see exactly what you are paying for.

h2
What makes a bathroom renovation more expensive
ul
relocating risers, floor drains and sanitary ware to new positions
concealed cistern frames and a shower without a tray, which requires precise slopes
large-format tiles or stone, a complex layout
backlit niches, underfloor heating, several lighting scenes
custom furniture and non-standard sizes
a poor substrate: levelling walls and floors
p

Each of these items is visible at the survey stage, so the extra cost never comes as a surprise halfway through the works. If the budget is tight, we suggest what can be dropped without compromising quality and what is better kept.
h2
What you should never save on
p

The most expensive mistakes in a bathroom are the hidden ones. Poor waterproofing, wrong slopes, missing access hatches and weak ventilation only show up once the tiles are on, and fixing them means tearing everything out. So save on decor and colour, not on the technology. We carry out these stages strictly to specification and show them in photo reports.

h2
How to get an honest estimate
ol
a survey that checks the risers, the ventilation and the condition of the substrate
decisions on the plan: what changes, what stays, which sanitary ware
an estimate where works and materials are listed as separate items
changes agreed before the start, so the crew does not decide them on the fly
a contract that fixes the scope and the amount
p

Be wary of a single-figure estimate with no breakdown: it is hard to see what is included and what you will have to pay extra for. A good estimate can be read line by line and compared with another one.
h2
Sanitary ware and furniture direct from China
p

Sanitary ware, mixer taps, mirrors and bathroom furniture are a noticeable part of the budget. They can be ordered directly from China: in the Ozdoba catalogue the minimum order is from $500, we do not sell single items, and delivery takes 30–60 days, so it is worth ordering in advance. Details of how we fit out a project are on our [turnkey procurement](/en/turnkey-procurement) page.

faq: How much does a bathroom renovation cost in Kyiv?

We do not quote a separate fixed price: it depends on the area, the tiles, the sanitary ware and the scope of works. Turnkey apartment renovation starts from $550 per m², and the cost of the bathroom is calculated in the estimate after a survey.
What affects the price of a bathroom renovation the most?
Relocating sanitary ware and risers, the choice of tiles and sanitary ware, concealed cistern frames, a shower without a tray and the condition of the substrate.
Can you renovate just the bathroom without the whole apartment?
Yes, we take on bathrooms and toilets as separate projects. We quote the exact figure after a survey.
Can I order sanitary ware and bathroom furniture from China?
Yes, through the Ozdoba catalogue: minimum order from $500, we do not sell single items, delivery from China takes 30–60 days.
